title: Back in the Room Where It Happens: Why ‘Hamilton’ Is Sparking Even More Joy for Leslie Odom Jr. This Time Around
summary: Broadway's original Aaron Burr is thrilling the West End with his return to Lin-Manuel Miranda's zeitgeist-capturing show. Here, Odom Jr. reveals exactly why he chose to come back — and how his years away from 'Hamilton' changed everything: "I'm having the time of my life."
